description_en: Deletes a dedicated host group. Before you call the API operation, you must migrate the dedicated hosts in the host group to another host group
description_zh: 删除一个专有宿主机组，操作前请先将该专有宿主机组下的专有宿主机迁移至其他专有宿主机组
kebab_example: aliyun ecs delete-dedicated-host-cluster --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --dedicated-host-cluster-id dc-bp12wlf6am0vz9v20000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteDedicatedHostCluster

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the host group. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 专有宿主机组所在的地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html查看最新的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the host group
parameters.name: dedicated_host_cluster_id
